content.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nano-Cap Nexalin's Drug-Free Alternative For Alzheimer's Shows Improved Memory, Cognitive Function In Small Study
content.summary: On Thursday, Nexalin Technology, Inc (NASDAQ:NXL) (NASDAQ:NXLIW) announced results from a clinical trial of its Deep Intracranial Frequency Stimulation (DIFS) technology for mild Alzheimer’s disease. The full results have been published in Alzheimer’s Research & Therapy. The study demonstrated improvements in memory and cognitive function for patients with mild Alzheimer’s disease using DIFS technology.
